suites.title: OUT OF LIFE
suites.moods: Disillusionment; Emptiness; Yearning; Loss; Anxiety; Desire for freedom; Quest for truth.
suites.signs: Chiaroscuro tableaux; Labyrinths; Fire escapes; Fading rooms; Whispers (Sonsign); Flickering portraits; Crystal-Images of otherworlds.

stanzas.voiceover: What we've made, we don't want. What we've sold — to the world, to ourselves — doesn't exist. I look for a way out: through the hallways, within the drawers, and fire escapes.
The vape gathers, inside and out. My vision blurs. I move toward the window — and you only get further away. More haze.

stanzas.screen_text: IT WAS THE MAZE CONSTRUCTED BY A TAINTED LOVE
stanzas.voiceover: It was the maze, constructed by a tainted love. You fall off the fire escape, into darkness — and the city streaks upward like it's leaving too.

stanzas.screen_text: TRIP ON MY OWN WORDS - FALLING OUT OF LIFE
stanzas.voiceover: I trip on my own words, falling out of life — and find where you go when you leave. The gap between us breathes, and never closes.

stanzas.screen_text: UNTIL IT GETS AS DARK AS BLACK
WHERE YOU GO WHEN YOU LEAVE - PART 2 OF 3: FUTURE

suites.title: FLASHING LIGHTS
suites.moods: Anxiety; Helplessness; Despair; Desensitization; Child-like fear; Desire to escape; Self-preservation; Emotional numbness.
suites.signs: Headlights; Sirens; Flashing lights; Walls caving; Exploding stars (concussion); Broken rings/chains; Crumbled paper hearts; VHS static; Ghost children; Ticking clocks; Empty roads.

stanzas.screen_text: A SET OF WALLS CAVING INWARD
stanzas.voiceover: It was the type of silent scream a trapped lover makes to escape: a pending marriage, a concussion, a set of walls caving inward.

stanzas.screen_text: TRYING TO SEE IN THE DARK
stanzas.voiceover: An emergency call while tossing and turning — the silent call a man makes to the mirror after midnight, to digest a truth.
A winless insomnia. An epiphany of a road winding down. My eyes dilate — and we go through.

I was six, I recall, when the ghost of a dead and love-less seven-year-old appeared, and shared that my parents' marriage wouldn't last. A warm, heavy breeze in winter, where a child is left home alone.

stanzas.screen_text: TWO SOULS ON A ROAD WINDING DOWN
stanzas.voiceover: Curtains pulled, and blinds up as far and as wise as possible — to see flashing lights, and the whispering screams of two souls on a road winding down.

stanzas.screen_text: NO TEARS - NO LOVE TO GIVE
stanzas.voiceover: And no tears, and no fucks, and no love to give. The ghost hands me a tambourine — and I throw it through the window.

suites.title: HOW TO BREAK OFF AN ENGAGEMENT
suites.moods: Disillusionment; Emptiness; Desolation; Cleansing; Resignation; Sadness; Seeking liberation; Confronting lost ideals; Rebuilding life; Self-redefinition.
suites.signs: Diamond ring on crack; Fraying infinity symbol; Empty temple/choir/pools; Spiderwebs; Faint ashes; Crumbling pillars; Halo-like rings (dimming); Torn wrapping paper; Parcels outside doors; Stone threshold cracked; Thunder/Rain; Fading photographs; "Return to sender" boxes; Shattered tambourine; Rotting bread; Soiled blankets; Divergent footprints; Lightning.

stanzas.screen_text: HOW TO BREAK OFF AN ENGAGEMENT

stanzas.voiceover: Ode to forever — a tambourine sounds off an empty temple, empty choir stands, empty prayer lines.
And abandoned baptism pools. It flies in through the rose window — still whole.
Pews taken by cobwebs, and doused in disintegration. Spirits have left salvations in opened gift boxes, placed outside the side doors.

It thunders. Then rains until nothing remains. What was once love, now goods — broken and sealed apart by lightning. Daily breads, soaked and delivered rotted by rain; and blankets, soiled by venomous puppeteers.

stanzas.screen_text: ODE TO TWO SETS OF MUD-IMPRINTED FOOTSTEPS
stanzas.voiceover: Ode to the storm ending. Ode to two sets of mud-imprinted footsteps, leading away from what the water kept.

stanzas.screen_text: AND A TAMBOURINE SHATTERED INTO PIECES
stanzas.voiceover: And a tambourine, shattered into pieces. What if I followed this trail, to where the broken pieces have washed ashore?

suites.title: NEVERMORE
suites.moods: Solitude; Reflection; Determination; Peace; Quiet confidence; Vulnerability (initial search); Desire for self-reclamation; Overcoming past suffering; Seeking authenticity; Embracing inner wholeness.
suites.signs: Broken pieces/Ashes/Debris; Night seawater's floor; Calm whispers/Muted trees/Silence; Throbbing heart/Familiar heart/Reclaimed heart/Dusk settled heart; Sad blue note; Puzzle pieces of faith/Mustard seeds; Moonlit night’s garden fields/Golden hue plants; Weeds/Memories hide; Two hands/Dusted hands; "Nevermore" (Mantra); Lost soul/Won at the world.

stanzas.screen_text: WHERE THE BROKEN PIECES HAVE WASHED ASHORE
stanzas.voiceover: What if I followed this trail, to where the broken pieces have washed ashore — and the ashes of expired wildfires cover sands, and debris lifted from the night sea water's floor.
The waves calm to folded whispers; the winds mute the trees. The right level of silence, to find a throbbing heart — it used to be mine. I lift it with care: nevermore.
What if I followed this reclaimed heart, to where the puzzle pieces of faith are handcrafted — scrambled and scattered as mustard seeds into the vast moonlit night's garden fields.

stanzas.screen_text: THE PLANTS IN A GOLDEN HUE BLOOM, FACED TOWARD ME
stanzas.voiceover: The plants in a golden hue bloom, and face toward me in anticipation. The weeds repel, falling into the shadows where our memories hide — and mean so little, in a moment of defeat — as I'm called forward.

stanzas.screen_text: TO SEARCH THE BARE GROUND FOR TWO HANDS
stanzas.voiceover: The clouds mute the stars for the deepest level of darkness — welcoming extra hard work, to search the bare ground for two hands.

stanzas.screen_text: THEY TOO USED TO BE MINE
stanzas.voiceover: Hands that once could touch dust after dusk, and feel good — they too used to be mine. I put them back on, with the care of my future at stake: nevermore.

suites.full_verse: What if I followed this trail, to where the broken pieces have washed ashore — and the ashes of expired wildfires cover sands, and debris lifted from the night sea water's floor. The waves calm to folded whispers; the winds mute the trees. The right level of silence, to find a throbbing heart — it used to be mine. I lift it with care: nevermore.

poem_legos.location_L: Night Ocean Shoreline — Wildfire ashes over sand and ancient debris washed ashore from the seabed.
poem_legos.entity_E: The Shoreline Wanderer / Recoverer of the Lost Heart.
poem_legos.goal_G: Reclaiming the Lost Heart — Tracking washed-up wreckage to locate and salvage his former capacity for feeling.
poem_legos.obstacle_O: Wildfire Ashes & Sea Debris — The desolate wreckage of past burns and the roar of ocean waves obscuring the heart.
poem_legos.shift_S: Waves calm to folded whispers and winds mute the trees, producing the exact silence needed to hear the heart throbbing in the sand.
poem_legos.solution_U: Sacred Reclamation — Lifting the recovered beating heart with delicate care and sealing the boundary: 'nevermore.'

suites.title: BLOODLINES
suites.moods: Burdened aspiration; Quiet defiance; Solemn determination; Inherited melancholy; Righteous indignation; Yearning for agency; Seeking cosmic permission; Transforming inherited pain; Asserting personal power; Giving voice to the unspoken.
suites.signs: Earth/Stars/Galaxies/New universe; Humid basements/Mattress pads/Wood beams (uncomforting); Forbidden lines/Battered & bruised history; Tears that spoke; Blood/Hands/Fingerprints; Sun-kissing skin; Deepening voice/Baritone of a million cries/Unanswered plight; "Beware of me."; "To dream was to prevail.".

stanzas.screen_text: TO ASK IF I CAN NAME MY OWN STARS
stanzas.voiceover: Now go, they tell me. To ask if I can inherit the earth — to ask if I can name my own stars. Even galaxies, if I may.

The past, too, was waiting for me — coming of age in the shared rooms of humid basements as bedrooms; mattress pads where the wood beams of Southern pine could comfort my spine. It didn't. To dream was to prevail.

stanzas.screen_text: TO ASK IF I CAN INVENT A NEW UNIVERSE
stanzas.voiceover: They tell me: ask if I can invent a new universe — if God would let me, little ole me, award a blessing here and there. Even grant miracles.

In uncertain times, in forsaken times. Their blood flows through my hands — fingerprints that orchestra great powers — sun-kissing my skin, deepening my voice to a baritone of a million cries. Beware of me.

stanzas.screen_text: KISSED BY THE HYMNS OUR CREATOR COMPOSED
stanzas.voiceover: The gates open with wings — gifted from evolution, and made of marble stones kissed by the hymns our Creator composed, with an orchestra of our ancestors' wildest dreams, to welcome us.

stanzas.screen_text: TO FOLLOW COMETS TO THE CAPITAL CITY
stanzas.voiceover: Poets, who eased generations down yellow brick roads — and plucked our souls out of their secret places, to follow comets to the capital city of our collective consciousness.
Resurrecting Atlantis. Here we are all one — the pact we've made here with nature, abandoned and hoped for the best, back on life.

stanzas.screen_text: A RELEARNED CURRENCY, WE REASSESS AS THE ADMISSION
stanzas.voiceover: A relearned currency, we reassess as the admission. But here we are all safe. An unfamiliar, flickering candle light, illuminating smiles at night.
Where shadows cast from narrow streets beaming with love — in the joyful noises that color rainbows, and give us infinite time to heal, and set clouds free.

stanzas.screen_text: I KNOW MY SOUL, AND IT COULD STAY HERE FOREVER
stanzas.voiceover: I know my soul — and it could stay here forever. Leaving behind crosshairs for continuums, and strains for serendipity.

stanzas.screen_text: A CITY BORN IN UNISON OUT OF THE PUREST OF FICTIONS
stanzas.voiceover: A city born in unison, out of the purest of fictions — welcoming me, and welcoming all.

suites.title: DJ TURN ME UP
suites.moods: Vulnerability; Despair; Defiance; Yearning for recognition; Need for voice; Asserting independence; Overcoming silence.
suites.signs: DJ/Turntables/Microphone; Ghosts (Crystal-Image); Fading vineyards; Broken hearts/rings; One-way streets; Blank billboards; Cosmic distances; Daisy petals; Heartbeat waveform.

stanzas.voiceover: DJ, turn me up, please. Eyes wide shut, chin nested at the arch of the weight of these spoken words.

stanzas.screen_text: I HAVE A LOVE STORY TO TELL
stanzas.voiceover: I have a love story to tell — of ghosts, whispering unfolded dilutions, birthed in purity, and dying in the vineyards of sun-soaked evergreen fields, unnourished.
One by one, treasures escaping — devaluing themselves after unsullied stars diminished their glares. I walked a thousand light years to be heard. So DJ — please — turn me up.

So I can speak: of wedding bands diverging across abstract skies of wounded souls. Of a shared home, boxed and trucked on separate one-way streets — not built with U-turns, or stop, maybe-we-shouldn't signs.
A love story of years — eleven years — each plunkled off as daisy petals. We love, we not. Of a future gone swiftly, and a past left empty-handed.
To pick a road: of heavy rain. Or of frontal fog. Or of dimmed night lights under a cloud — with a silver lining.
Now, turning forth to face delights and shadows — one night at a time; one tear at a time; one open mic at a time. Chin now nested high, and volume turnt up.

suites.title: NEWLY SINGLE
suites.moods: Liberation; Detachment; Vulnerability; Self-awareness; Curiosity; Desire for self-reclamation; Embracing solitude; Seeking new pleasures.
suites.signs: Dance floor/Club lights; Escaping soul; Empty silhouette; Broken vinyl hearts; X-ray ribs; Planet equator; Ice baths; Digital scripture; Trance circles; Cosmic mountains; Infinity symbol.

stanzas.screen_text: A CROWDED FLOOR OF SWEATED PERFUMES
stanzas.voiceover: Pulsing, and head throbbing from the music — and empty, on a crowded floor of sweated perfumes and temptations.

stanzas.screen_text: HE CAN NOW JUST BE FLESH AND BONES
stanzas.voiceover: The soul escapes my body, and leaves him on the dance floor — just flesh and bones. Rejection and heartache hit different, with no feelings afloat.
I want my soul to imagine my body. Watch strangers collide and spark electric currents that gamut the mood. We want him to be the last to leave.

stanzas.screen_text: A PLANET MUCH LARGER THAN MY OWN
stanzas.voiceover: Now let us put my soul in the middle of an open field — at the equator of a planet much larger than my own, and much hotter.
Cool me down: pouring unfiltered water out of ice baths, salted from the closest moons, from angles of the newest religions — their graces curse or bless me. Only infinity will tell.
Now bring my soul back to my body: to lean back, breathe in the smoke that fills the room — how good it is to finally get acquainted with the night.

stanzas.screen_text: WHAT ISNT MINE, I STILL CAN NOT GIVE
stanzas.voiceover: Unfamiliar, yet relatable mountains in the distance; wandering thoughts within reach. Accepting you'll never say, nor feel, my love was real. What isn't mine, I still can not give.

stanzas.screen_text: WHAT ISN'T MINE, I STILL CAN NOT GIVE.

suites.full_verse: Pulsing, and head throbbing from the music — and empty, on a crowded floor of sweated perfumes and temptations. The soul escapes my body, and leaves him on the dance floor — just flesh and bones. Rejection and heartache hit different, with no feelings afloat.

poem_legos.location_L: Sweated, Crowded Nightclub Dance Floor Lit by Throbbing Bass.
poem_legos.entity_E: The Newly Single Man (Bifurcated into Dancing Flesh and Ascending Soul).
poem_legos.goal_G: Surviving Post-Breakup Heartache — Navigating sensual distractions while emotionally hollowed out.
poem_legos.obstacle_O: Throbbing Music, Temptation, & Acute Rejection — The suffocating crush of dancing bodies pressing against inner numbness.
poem_legos.shift_S: The soul detaches and floats upward out of the physical body, leaving an empty vessel of flesh and bones on the floor.
poem_legos.solution_U: Anesthetized Elevation — Overcoming heartbreak by floating above sensation, surviving with zero emotional drag.

suites.title: YET, HEARD
suites.moods: Unspoken longing; Enduring connection; Melancholy; Comfort; Seeking validation; Processing grief; Finding peace; Accepting what cannot be changed.
suites.signs: Sealed dialogue bubbles; Glass hearts; Gift boxes; Moon/Puddles; Conversation tapes; Aging silhouettes; Cracked faith; Maternal/Paternal ears; Tears/Meteors; Inner harbor.

stanzas.screen_text: WE TALK FOR YEARS AND TRAVEL THROUGH TIME
stanzas.voiceover: Before I go, we look at the moon the way we used to see it. We talk for years, travel through time — we grow old together, I believe. Maybe we could have it all.

Before I go, I call on my mother — in tears, speaking of an abyss she's never known. We talk for years, re-closet wounds, and re-explain my way of birth. Even after prayer: what isn't mine, I still can not give.

Before I go, I call on my father — his calming demeanor summoned from the yonders. We walk for years, east toward the sunrises, retracing his footsteps — my tears falling in the wave shadows of the inner harbor.
We stroll, father and son, hearted and shaken. Someone borrowed, and someone blue — yet, broken. Yet, heard.

Before I go, I call on my mother — in tears, speaking of an abyss she's never known. Before I go, I call on my father — his calming demeanor summoned from the yonders. We stroll, father and son, hearted and shaken. Someone borrowed, and someone blue — yet, broken. Yet, heard.

stanzas.screen_text: I WASN'T LOOKING FOR A RIDE, BUT HERE YOU ARE
stanzas.voiceover: I wasn't looking for a ride, but here you are — blissful, and oddly sensitive. I rub my aggressions into your steel coverings, and hop on.

stanzas.screen_text: I LET THE NOISE BLOCK THE NOISE
stanzas.voiceover: Loneliness is having everything with no one to tell — being everywhere, with no one to love. I let the noise block the noise. The way I ride: eyes turn, heads twist — and prove the magic still exists.

stanzas.screen_text: THE TEASE OF DISTANT STARS SUBSIDES
stanzas.voiceover: All preparations to live and dream in darkness, I no longer desire. The moon settles, and the tease of distant stars subsides — and I can see a morning ahead for me.

stanzas.screen_text: A MORNING I COULD BELIEVE IN
stanzas.voiceover: It looks like a morning I could believe in — a morning where loss and life aren't so — well — ripe with sunlight that's deceptively warm. The chirping of birds, fueling of nests, spring out of the night that has covered me.

stanzas.screen_text: EVEN HERE, IT'S CHILLY IN THE MORNING
stanzas.voiceover: With my own curiosities, for a chance at an end wherever everything will be OK. I want to live in this feeling forever — blissful, and oddly innocent.
Riding in a way you can't help but double-click — and prove the magic still exists. Even here, it's chilly in the morning.

suites.full_verse: A hot minute. The haze gathers on the water — and everything I built here learns to be weather: the city, the temple, the harbor. It takes me last, and from the ground up. I am reluctant — but I have been weather before. All black again. But no walls this time. A life flashes the way a reel does: the window, the tambourine, the field, the stars, the candle, the daisy, the ride, the temple, the hourglass. Our dance together is a victory. An old door, from a vintage somewhere. It opens on a slow party — the kind I once fell out of a window to escape. This time, I choose the door.

poem_legos.location_L: Atmospheric Dissolution Shoreline (City, Temple, Harbor Becoming Weather) & Vintage Doorway.
poem_legos.goal_G: Conscious Narrative Transcendence — Allowing the built world to dissolve into weather and choosing his exit with dignity.
poem_legos.obstacle_O: Reluctance to Dissolve & Darkness — The terrifying collapse of all physical structures into black void.
poem_legos.shift_S: Life flashes like a film reel (window, tambourine, ride, temple, hourglass); what was once a traumatic escape becomes a dance of victory.
poem_legos.solution_U: Choosing the Door — Rather than falling out of a window to escape, consciously and calmly walking through the door into the gathering.
